product_results.description: Feel that satisfying squish with Crayola Globbles Fidget Toys—a colorful, creative way to relieve stress, stay focused, and have fun! This 6-count pack includes vibrant, reusable squish balls that stick, stack, squish, and sling without leaving a sticky residue. Whether you need stress relief toys for adults, sensory toys for kids, or classroom fidget tools, Globbles deliver endless tactile fun. Each ball has a super sticky, squeezable texture perfect for anxiety relief, sensory stimulation, and calming play. Great for kids with ADHD, autism, or sensory processing needs, they offer a quiet, mess-free way to self-regulate. When they lose stickiness, rinse with soap and water to refresh. This makes a delightful Easter basket essential—perfect as a cheerful Easter basket stuffer that adds creative fun to any spring celebration. Compact and portable, they’re perfect for home, classrooms, travel, or the office. Use them as party favors, classroom rewards, or fun desk toys. Safe, nontoxic, and ACMI Certified, these fidget toys are ideal for ages 4 and up.

summary.text: Customers find these fidget toys visually appealing and fun to play with, particularly enjoying how they can be squished and thrown. They are easy to clean by rinsing with soap and water, and customers of all ages enjoy them, with one customer noting their kids play with them for hours. The durability and stickiness receive mixed reviews - while some say they stay on ceilings for months without falling, others report they break almost immediately and aren't really sticky. Value for money and cleanliness are also mixed aspects, with some finding them well worth the money while others say they're not worth the price, and while they don't leave residue, they tend to attract dirt and hair.
